text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning to flip feature flag `enable_fast_cache_v3` in prod tomorrow at 02:30 PT. Who can own the rollout and smoke checks? :eyes:
Sam: I can own the deploy + canary. Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with ~15m observation windows.
Josh: I can run the smoke suite and watch traces. Quick Q: what's the safe default for new tenants?
Olivia: Safe default should remain OFF for new tenants — opt-in only. Service-side fallback must stay on: if tenant not opted in, use cache_v2.
Sam: Preflight checklist I'll follow: 1) dashboard up, 2) alert for p50>250ms or error rate>0.5%, 3) rollback command ready, 4) notify #eng-oncall.
Emi: Rollback command (ops): `./ops/rollbacks/roll_flag.sh enable_fast_cache_v3 false --reason "latency"`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Please ensure kill-switch tag `fast_cache_killswitch` exists before starting.
Ryan: I'll tail infra logs and watch node resource usage: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=inference -f`
Maya: Sam — you're owner. Post a short smoke checklist when you start and tag me if anything looks off. If regression, flip flag back to false and ping #eng-oncall.
Sam: Smoke checklist I'll post at start: 
- `curl -sS https://prod.api.redwood.ai/health` should return 200
- run 5 sample requests against v1/generate and check outputs
- confirm p50/p95 on the dashboard
- KV cache hit rate and miss rate checks
I'll also add header `X-Canary: fast-cache` so logs are filterable.
Josh: If all good after a 30m soak at 25% we'll bump to 100%. If anything odd, rollback immediately and record notes.
Olivia: Who signs off to go to 100%? Maya or do we need both Maya + Prod?
Maya: I'll do final sign-off unless I'm offline — otherwise Sam proceed using the runbook and tag me via @Maya.
Emi: One extra: the safe-default guard in service is in PR #4523 and has been merged to main: `if not tenant_opted_in: use_cache_v2` — so default behavior is covered.
Sam: Ok starting at 02:30 PT. Will post timestamps and checklist results in-thread.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started — instances in canary pool (5%). Console: <https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/2241001234>
Ryan: Seeing first canary traffic. p50=180ms, errors=0. Will watch for 20m.
Josh: Smoke run: sample prompts OK, embeddings consistent, KV hit rate ~62% (expected).
Maya: :thumbsup: Proceed to 25% in 15m if stable.
Sam: Bumped to 25% at 2241002034 — monitoring.
Ryan: At 25% p50=200ms, p95=420ms, errors=0.2% — within our thresholds.
Emi: Noted, updating the rollout doc and linking the PR.
Sam: Everything looks stable, bumping to 100% now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout complete — `enable_fast_cache_v3 = true` for all prod tenants.
Maya: Nice work. Post-roll items: check billing delta, KV hit stable, QA to watch support channels for odd user reports. Document anomalies.
Josh: I'll grab the metrics and write a short blameless note with any interesting signals.
Sam: Quick rollback reminder if needed: `./ops/rollbacks/roll_flag.sh enable_fast_cache_v3 false` and ping #incidents.
Maya: Thanks team. Please drop a 1-2 line summary here when you have it and we'll close the loop.
